decisions.title: Do you agree with how a returned copy reaches the next member?
decisions.why: A member should hear the same day the copy is back.

options.label: The desk scan shelves it
options.detail: When the desk scans a returned copy, the server finds the first member in line and prints a hold slip.

options.label: A nightly job shelves returned copies
options.detail: Returned copies wait on a cart until the morning sort.

decisions.title: Do you agree with how a member is told a copy is ready?

options.label: Email, through the existing notices

options.detail: A new contract and a new service to run.
